label: ACE-Step 1.5 local generation adapter
summary: Use an explicitly operated ACE-Step 1.5 environment for optional text-, lyric-, or reference-audio generation, then bring every candidate back as unapproved song-local evidence with exact settings.

handoffs.label: Generate bounded musical candidates
handoffs.intent: Explore one declared musical question with fresh variants without replacing owned performances or presenting model output as a finished song.
inputs: A captured production request and one player-facing hypothesis rather than only genre tags
Optional original lyrics or reference audio whose upload, processing, performer consent, and derivative-use rights are explicitly documented
A fresh seed for exploration or an exact recorded seed for diagnostic replay
outputs: New lossless or highest-quality available candidate audio outside recordings/raw and FINAL
A sidecar recording ACE-Step version, exact model ids, seed, prompts, negative prompts, duration, modes, source checksums, hardware/backend, and generation time
A separate listening decision that keeps, changes, alternates, or stops the candidate
steps: Inspect `eprs doctor --workflow local-ai-collaboration` and the official ACE-Step hardware guide before starting any environment or downloading models.
Start the local UI or REST sidecar explicitly; EPRS discovery never starts it, sends material to it, or makes it public.
Generate the smallest useful batch with fresh entropy, preserve each exact candidate and settings, and compare alternatives in both audition orders.
Freeze a useful candidate into an EPRS experiment or source-aware process and record what musical relationship it contributes.
verification: Confirm the returned file opens, has the declared duration and channel/sample properties, is not clipped or truncated, and matches its recorded checksum.

Confirm all human/reference inputs remain unchanged and that model output, technical success, and an attractive first listen do not imply originality, rights clearance, mix approval, or release approval.

handoffs.label: Return editable generative stems
handoffs.intent: Use generation or extraction modes to obtain parts that can be arranged alongside owned recordings while keeping the original candidate and timing origin intact.
inputs: One checksummed candidate, an explicit role for each requested stem, and a declared common time-zero
The exact model/mode and a musical reason for separating, repainting, completing, or replacing a part
outputs: Common-start lossless stems with the untouched candidate retained as the parent
A reproducibility sidecar and an explicit note for bleed, artifacts, unknown phase relationships, or model-added content
steps: Export every stem from the same declared operation and retain silence so files share time zero.
Bring stems into an EPRS mix or interchange package without automatic normalization, warping, tuning, limiting, or source deletion.
Audition the stems together and against the parent candidate before making any keep decision.
verification: Verify duration, alignment, file integrity, source checksum, and whether the stems reconstruct or intentionally differ from the parent.
Record audible bleed, artifacts, missing parts, and the separate musical review; do not infer clean isolation from named stem files.

preserve: Immutable human recordings, explicit consent and rights context, generated candidates, exact seeds/prompts/models/settings, and the editable source of every accepted decision
The distinction between human performance, researched influence, synthetic proposal, selected stem, approved mix, and cleared release
avoid: Silently installing models, starting services, uploading private family recordings, imitating a living artist by name, or using an unclear-rights reference as conditioning material
Overwriting candidates, hiding failed generations, treating a seed as a guarantee of cross-version reproducibility, or claiming that an open software license clears training-data or output rights
